newsitem.title: USA: Fleetwood notes demand, backlog level drop.
newsitem.headline: Fleetwood notes demand, backlog level drop.

text.p: Fleetwood Enterprises Inc said Tuesday that it is experiencing softening demand for manufactured homes and recreational vehicles and that order backlogs are below year-ago levels.
The maker of manufactured housing and recreational vehicles said additionally that "sales in the early part of the third quarter are running slightly behind last year's pace."
On Tuesday Fleetwood reported second quarter earnings of $0.68 a share, compared to $0.52 per share for the year-ago quarter.
